title: Two Hamzahs in One Word - ءَامَنتُمْ in Surah Shuʿarāʾ
titleEn: Two Hamzahs in One Word - ءَامَنتُمْ in Surah Shuʿarāʾ
description: The word ءَامَنتُمْ in Surah al-Shuʿarāʾ is paired with an additional أَ for Imams Nafi', Abu 'Amr, Ibn Kathir, Ibn 'Amir, Hamzah, Kisai and Shu'bah. Thus while for the Imam Hafs the rules of two hamzahs don't apply here as for him there is only 1 hamzah in this word, for the remaining qurra they do.

tashil_of_second.title: Tashῑl of 2nd
tashil_of_second.description: These qurra will pair an extra hamzah to the start of this word which will be read with tahqiq and the 2nd hamzah with tashῑl.

tahqiq_of_both.title: Taḥqīq of both
tahqiq_of_both.description: Both hamzahs will be read clearly (taḥqīq) with no changes made to either - ءَأَٰمَنتُمْ
